description: This file generates HTML reports for LLM autocompletion test cases, including index and individual test case pages, with approval/rejection tracking and navigation features.

methods.name: parseApprovalContent
methods.description: Extracts prefix, completion, and suffix from approval content based on cursor position.

methods.name: formatApprovalContent
methods.description: Formats approval content with HTML spans highlighting prefix, suffix, and completion.

methods.name: loadApprovals
methods.description: Loads approval and rejection files for a given test case category and name.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: highlightCursor
methods.description: Highlights cursor marker in input text with HTML span.

methods.name: generateIndexHtml
methods.description: Generates the main index HTML page listing all test cases grouped by category.

methods.name: generateTestCaseHtml
methods.description: Generates detailed HTML page for a specific test case, including approvals, context files, and navigation.

methods.name: generateHtmlReport
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates loading test cases, generating report files, and saving them to disk.
